notes:
REF-BM-02: Only the page title is collected; description, favicon, and preview image are not.
REF-BM-03: Title can be edited only after saving; description editing and pre-save metadata editing are missing.
REF-BM-04: Only title and tags are editable; URL, description, and note are not.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate creation is prevented and the existing item can be shown, but the flow does not open it for editing.
REF-BM-07: List items expose title and tags but no description or favicon.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title and URL (plus tags), but no description or note fields exist.
REF-BM-14: Search does not interpret #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are not parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is not implemented.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: There is no action applying to all bookmarks in the current filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: The list has only fixed newest-first ordering and no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are not implemented.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are not implemented.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-29: Saved search/tag bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are not implemented.
